name: Taroki Polish, call king
description: Taroki z królami (Taroki call king) is a four-player Polish tarot game from Kozy near Bielsko Biała. Bidder chooses partner by calling a King (not the XIX). 54-card pack, 22 trumps; highest skiż, then XXI down to I, the lowest trump. Objective: bidder's side wins by taking more than half the card points in tricks. Bonuses for all kings, last trick with lowest trump, etc. Card values: skiż/XXI/kings 5, queens 4, cavaliers 3, jacks 2, others 1. From Austrian Tarock tradition in Galicia/Silesia.

From Kozy near Bielsko-BiaÅ‚a (Poland). Austrian Tarock tradition in Galicia/Silesia; bidder calls a King (not XIX) for partner. 54-card pack, point-trick with bonuses.
Four players; temporary partnerships (declarer plus holder of called king vs others, or declarer alone vs three).
54-card Taroki pack: 22 trumps (skiż, XXI down to I) and four eight-card suits (K, Q, C, J plus four pips).

Dealer deals 6 cards face down to table (talon), then remaining 48 in batches of 6 so each player receives 12 cards; anticlockwise. Player opposite dealer may refuse to cut; then dealer deals 6 to talon and four packets of 12, and each player in turn chooses a packet.

items.text: Higher penalty for giving up with king in talon: Some players set the payment for giving up when the called king is found in the talon at 5 game points rather than 2.
Announced trul score: Some written rules specify 5 game points rather than 4 for announced trul.
